Beautiful natural-light still life of an unfurled yoga mat, Pilates ring, cork blocks and leafy plant in an airy studio, peach lavender and dark aubergine editorial design. No people, body transformation, therapeutic promises or fitness brand logos. Exact headline: "Hazle espacio al movimiento.". Exact secondary line: "Busca clases de yoga y Pilates por tu comuna.". Include exact brand "ConectaProIA", action "Cuéntanos qué necesitas y tu comuna.", contact "WhatsApp +56 9 8343 4503", website "conectaproia.cl", benefit "Buscar contactos es gratis.", footer "El servicio lo cobra cada prestador. Confirma disponibilidad y valores." Finished professional Chilean contact-directory advertisement. Large readable Spanish type, correct accents and punctuation, generous side margins, clear hierarchy, all mandatory copy legible on mobile. Keep footer at a readable size, split into lines as needed. No other text. No fake testimonials, verified claims, provider counts, prices, free contracted services, guaranteed outcomes, guaranteed availability or universal geographic coverage. Keep all important copy within middle 80% height, above Story UI, and allow generous side margins.
